QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Minar Forest in Crisis
QuestInfo.0: #p2081006# is pondering how to overcome the crisis at Minar Forest. Ask for more information.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081006# says the Halflingers will figure out a way to resolve the crisis in Minar Forest. Go to #m240000000# and tell #p2081000# about the situation in western Minar Forest.
QuestInfo.2: You told #p2081000# about the situation in western Minar Forest. #p2081000# was relieved that Moira is safe but concerned that Minar Forest was in trouble.\r\n

0.0: We've taken care of the most urgent problems, but until we know the cause of these falling stars, anything can happen. We must warn the Halflingers that Minar Forest is in danger. Will you do that for me?

yes.0: Please go to #b#m240000000##k and tell #r#p2081000##k the situation. The Halflingers have watched over Minar Forest for forever. They'll know what to do.\r\n

no.0: I'd do it if I could, but you see these chains?\r\n

1.0: What took you so long? I was worried the forest ate you.

yes.0: Oh dear, I knew the star would cause trouble. I'm glad Moira is okay, but this issue is even bigger than I imagined, and my imagination is pretty vast.

default.0: #b#m240000000##k's #r#p2081000##k needs to know that Minar Forest is in danger.\r\n
